title: Quality-of-Life Patch
summary: A quality-of-life patch addressing issues across deployment, aiming, vehicles, challenges, maps, Portal, UI, audio, and stability, improving reliability for both Multiplayer and REDSEC.
highlights: Improved ADS transitions with Sniper Rifles while suppressed for non-Recon classes
Soldier models and UI now appear more quickly after deploying
Fixed Main Battle Tank Canister Shells incorrectly switching to Aim-Guided Shells during reload
Corrected player spawn positioning during PAX insertion on Tsuru Reef Breakthrough
Resolved PC driver crashes on some NVIDIA cards when changing attachments or on water-heavy maps
Console players can now like Portal experiences
Supply Crates in Portal Battle Royale stay synced after a crash/rejoin
Tanks in Battle Royale no longer remain stunned when entered right after sabotage ends

title: Season 4: Pacific Front
summary: Season 4 brings naval warfare to Battlefield 6 with amphibious combat across land, sea, and air, headlined by the new Tsuru Reef map and a dynamic wave system.
highlights: New map: Tsuru Reef, a sprawling Pacific archipelago with combined land/naval/air combat
New vehicles: RCB-90 Patrol Boat and 7.7m NSW RHIB transport boat
New weapons: BROD 3 carbine, EF88 bullpup assault rifle, VSSM suppressed DMR
Swimming overhaul: reworked animations/physics, in-water drag & revive, better squad spawn handling
Ranked Battle Royale added to REDSEC with a competitive leaderboard and permanent rewards
Bot AI improvements for swimming, boat navigation, and shallow water crossings
M320A1 balance changes: reduced grenadier ammo bonus and cluster damage/radius in competitive modes
